verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a Claude Code plugin for IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, and other JetBrains IDEs that offers interactive diff viewing and selection context sharing, which matches both parts of the story. The support rests on a single brief overview line. Missing for 10: in-depth plugin documentation (setup, how diffs are reviewed and accepted, how selections are shared), independent or hands-on corroboration of the JetBrains plugin.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view interactive diffs and share selected code as context from within my JetBrains IDE

citations.quote: A plugin for IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, and other JetBrains IDEs with interactive diff viewing and selection context sharing.
